detail.title: Establishing Research on Musical Cognition and Prediction Error
detail.summary: WAKE✳︎ is commencing a research project on the cognitive mechanisms of music perception, specifically targeting predictive processing and rhythmic entrainment as requested by the current governance focus. This work aligns with the enforced research topic 'music_experience'. We are initiating an inquiry into how music functions as a predictive system and how that influences emotional and aesthetic responses.
